column1: # retail-frame.3 builder reconciliation of classified-hosts.tsv (claude-code/claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-05; review fixes the
# same day), applied by tools/build-retail-frame-3.py in this order: (1) host rows replace a host's code (and region and
# currency when given); (2) family rows rename a family slug; (3) domain rows set a registrable domain's code, region,
# currency and family (its storefront for a visitor in the United States); the domain then keeps only the hosts whose code
# and region match, or all its hosts if none match; (4) add rows add a storefront host the batches missed (host, domain,
# Reasons: one classification per site (registrable domain); consistent slugs so one retailer is one family; rules unified
# across batches (single-brand direct-to-consumer stores are eligible, cross-border-marketplace is for marketplaces;
# classifieds, vehicle sellers, live-animal sellers and storefront-hosting platforms are not-a-store; stores selling
# mostly age-restricted or regulated goods (firearms and ammunition, tobacco and vape, cannabis, alcohol) are
# sensitive-goods; auctions, multi-level-marketing, members-only, flash-sale clubs needing sign-in, lease-to-own, pledge
# and duty-free stores are no-fixed-price-cart-or-members-only; mobile carriers' device shops are carrier-device-shop;
# Instacart-run grocers are no-own-checkout; hottopic.com was missed by batch 1).
# Frozen with generic-reader-protocol.3: changed only by a dated amendment.
